title: Agent Execution Integrity Benchmark (AEIB) & Sovereign Multi-Agent OS (SMAOS) Open Core Protocol Specification v1.0
description:
This deposit contains the open-core protocol specification, normative transport-to-disposition mapping contract (15 fault vectors), standalone SCITT-style receipt verifier (aeib_verify.py), industrial-protection-inspired execution governor (src/protection_governor.py), and 500-episode fault-injection benchmark harness for the Agent Execution Integrity Benchmark (AEIB v1.0).

AEIB solves the "last-mile settlement gap" in enterprise autonomous agent runtimes, where mid-flight network disruptions (such as HTTP 504 Gateway Timeouts or TCP resets) cause uncoordinated retries, resulting in duplicate financial mutations and ledger drift.

Key Contents:
1. Normative Contract: docs/transport-to-disposition-mapping.yaml (15 wire fault vectors)
2. Offline Verifier: Standalone Python receipt verifier (aeib_verify.py) executing with zero external network egress.
3. Execution Governor: Software state-machine safeguards implementing probe-failure escalation, manual lockout latching, and peer cancellation patterns.
4. Benchmark Suite: 500-episode deterministic fault-injection harness demonstrating 0 duplicate writes in simulation (Arm 4; Rule-of-Three 95% CI <= 0.60% under the simulated fault model).
